name: list_forms
description: List forms in the current team. Requires token ability `forms:read`.

name: get_form
description: Fetch a single form by public_id. Requires token ability `forms:read`.

name: create_form
description: Create a new form. Requires token ability `forms:write`.

name: update_form
description: Update a form. Requires token ability `forms:write`.

name: publish_form
description: Publish a form so it accepts submissions. Requires `forms:write`.

name: unpublish_form
description: Unpublish a form so it stops accepting submissions. Requires `forms:write`.

name: archive_form
description: Archive a form (soft-delete; reversible via restore). Requires `forms:write`.

name: restore_form
description: Restore a previously archived form. Requires `forms:write`.

name: send_test_autoresponder
description: Send a test autoresponder to the calling user. Requires `forms:test-email`.

name: send_test_notification
description: Send a test owner-notification to the calling user. Requires `forms:test-email`.

name: list_templates
description: List starter templates for forms, surveys, or funnels. Call before create_* when the user wants a template. Requires forms:read (form), surveys:read (survey), or funnels:read (funnel).

name: list_submissions
description: List submissions for a form. Requires token ability `submissions:read`.

name: get_submission
description: Fetch a single submission with its files. Requires `submissions:read`.

name: update_submission
description: Update a submission payload or status. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: delete_submission
description: Permanently delete a submission and its files. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: bulk_submissions
description: Apply a bulk action (delete, mark_spam, mark_not_spam) to up to 500 submissions. Requires `submissions:write`.

name: export_submissions
description: Export the first 500 submissions of a form as inline JSON. For larger exports use the REST API stream. Requires `submissions:export`.

name: get_submission_file
description: Return a short-TTL signed URL to download a submission file. Requires `submissions:read`.

name: mark_as_spam
description: Flag a submission as spam. Requires token ability `submissions:write`.

name: get_form_stats
description: Get 30-day stats for a form. Requires `submissions:read`.

name: list_webhooks
description: List webhooks for a form. Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: get_webhook
description: Fetch a single webhook (no secret). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: create_webhook
description: Create a webhook for a form. Returns the plaintext signing secret ONCE in this response. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: update_webhook
description: Update a webhook URL/label/active flag. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: delete_webhook
description: Delete a webhook. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
description: List the most recent webhook deliveries (default 50, max 200). Requires `webhooks:read`.

name: replay_webhook_delivery
description: Re-dispatch a previously sent webhook delivery. Requires `webhooks:write`.

name: list_surveys
description: List surveys belonging to the current team. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: get_survey
description: Fetch a single survey by public_id. Requires `surveys:read`.

name: create_survey
description: Create a new survey for the current team. Use this when the user asks to build a survey, questionnaire, quiz, or form with multiple screens (not a regular contact-style form). Requires `surveys:write`.

name: update_survey
description: Update survey config: name, fields, theme, settings, scoring, notification emails. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: publish_survey
description: Publish a survey - make it live and respondable. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: unpublish_survey
description: Unpublish a survey - return it to draft, stop accepting responses. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: delete_survey
description: Move a survey to trash (soft-delete). Recoverable from the dashboard within the retention window. Requires `surveys:write`.

name: list_funnels
description: List funnels for the current team. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: get_funnel
description: Get a funnel by public_id (preferred) or slug. Requires `funnels:read`.

name: create_funnel
description: Create a new funnel for the current team. Optional `template` hydrates a gallery starter via TemplateHydrator. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: update_funnel
description: Update funnel config and screens. Screens with an `id` matching an existing screen are updated in place; screens without an `id` are created; screens not referenced in the payload are deleted. Same diff applies to nested blocks. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: publish_funnel
description: Publish or unpublish a funnel. Identify by public_id (preferred) or slug. Requires `funnels:publish`.

name: delete_funnel
description: Move a funnel to trash (soft-delete). Recoverable from the dashboard within the retention window. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: get_funnel_analytics
description: Get funnel analytics summary. Requires `funnels:analytics`.

name: list_funnel_sessions
description: List recent sessions for a funnel. Requires `funnels:analytics`.

name: add_screen
description: Add a screen to a funnel. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: add_block
description: Add a block to a funnel screen. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_logic
description: Attach a logic rule (AND/OR DSL) to a block. Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_score
description: Attach a per-block score map (bucket → points). Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_pixel
description: Set browser-side pixel IDs on a funnel (GA4/GTM/Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn/Pinterest/Snap/Bing/Reddit/Twitter). Requires `funnels:write`.

name: set_capi_token
description: Configure server-side CAPI credentials for a vendor (meta|tiktok|linkedin|pinterest). Requires `funnels:write`.

name: list_links
description: List short links for the current team. Requires `links:read`.

name: get_link
description: Fetch one short link by id or slug. Requires `links:read`.

name: create_link
description: Create a new short link. Requires `links:write` and a paid plan.

name: update_link
description: Update an existing short link. Requires `links:write`.

name: delete_link
description: Soft-delete a short link. Requires `links:write`.

name: list_automations
description: List automations for a form. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation
description: Get a single automation with its steps. Requires `automations:read`.

name: create_automation
description: Create a new automation. Requires `automations:write`.

name: update_automation
description: Update an automation (top-level fields only). Requires `automations:write`.

name: enable_automation
description: Enable an automation. Requires `automations:write`.

name: disable_automation
description: Disable an automation. Requires `automations:write`.

name: run_automation
description: Manually trigger an automation. Requires `automations:run`.

name: list_automation_runs
description: List recent automation runs. Requires `automations:read`.

name: get_automation_run
description: Get an automation run with step outputs. Requires `automations:read`.

name: replay_automation_run
description: Replay a previous automation run. Requires `automations:run`.

name: delete_automation
description: Delete an automation (and its steps + runs). Permanent. Requires `automations:write`.

name: get_team
description: Get the current team summary. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_plan
description: Get the current team's plan, features, and limits. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_usage
description: Get the current team's usage for the current period. Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_subscription_state
description: Get the current team's subscription state (active, on_trial, on_grace_period, past_due, canceled, none). Requires `billing:read`.

name: get_ai_insights
description: Read AI insights for the current team. Returns `{locked: true}` when the plan lacks AI features. Requires `insights:read`.

name: regenerate_ai_insights
description: Trigger an AI insights regeneration. Idempotency-locked for 5 minutes. Requires `insights:write`.

name: list_tokens
description: List the calling user's API tokens. Requires `tokens:read`.

name: create_token
description: Mint a new API token. Requested abilities must be a subset of the calling token's abilities. Plaintext token is returned ONCE in this response. Requires `tokens:write`.

name: revoke_token
description: Revoke an API token by id. Refuses to revoke the token currently in use. Requires `tokens:write`.

name: get_framework_integration_catalog
description: Maximum-breadth catalog of Formspring ingestion patterns across frameworks (short snippets + docs links). Requires token ability `forms:read`. Use optional `category` and pagination (`page`, `per_page`, max 100 per page). Replace FORMSPRING_ENDPOINT in snippets with your form URL (e.g. https://your-host/f/{public_id}).
